criteria.test: no essential rule of the reference lifecycle is SOURCE_BLOCKED or SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS, no reference rule rests on a secondary source only, and the source wording of the reference rules is available (not translation-only)
all nine operational phases run in the reference (no phase missing; a phase closed only by an SF6 model variant does not count)
no essential manual source decision is substituted by a model assumption in the reference (manual review requirement = none)
no essential rule of the reference is DATA_BLOCKED (proxies do not unblock; the SIC-based Turtle correlation groups stay a research proxy, E4)

V4-D1 RESOLVED for the reference: every flagged session behind a reference trade verified by corporate-action evidence (CONFIRMED_UNDECLARED_SPLIT corrected in a versioned data PR, or CONFIRMED_GENUINE_MOVE) and the reference recomputed. The DQ-K5 / DQ-K3 quarantine is a diagnostic containment only and never satisfies this criterion (owner decision E1, 2026-10-24)
the reference ran on the frozen snapshot with research-v1, reconciled, deterministic, current code
entry and stop are executable point in time on the data used (no fill at a price unknown at the decision; no hypothetical short without borrow data); cost sensitivity measured

out-of-sample evidence from the prospective paper validation protocol SF6-PAPER-2027 (window from 2027-01-01, fixed before it opens; owner decision E2). No historical window qualifies: 2008-2015 (opened once in R14, survivorship-limited) and 2016-2026 (development data) FAIL this criterion and can at most earn PASS_WITH_DECLARED_LIMITS in the OUT_OF_SAMPLE_EVIDENCE dimension

ownerDecisions.decision: V4-D1 stays a genuine data-integrity blocker; no quarantine reading is a final solution or a certification exception; existing Tiingo / Marketstack corporate-action data and verifiable public filings may be checked in a targeted way, without new costs and without bulk requests
a versioned prospective paper validation protocol from 2027-01-01 (SF6-PAPER-2027); no historical data are called an untouched holdout; no permanent scheduler, no live trading
the Pocket Pivot stop and the Holy Grail trailing stay explicit research variants, never original rules; no automatic upgrade of measurement classes
SIC-based Turtle correlation groups stay research proxies; no certification on their basis
no additional EP / PS intraday requests; only a prioritised plan for better stratified coverage within the existing budget

evaluation by metrics and distributions, not by the identity of single trades; numerical reproducibility, trade stability and robustness are reported separately and the sensitivity of the portfolio studies stays visible
